certification.name: Offensive GCP Operations and Tactics Certification
certification.description: Covers GCP IAM enumeration and abuse, service account compromise, metadata exploitation, GKE and container attacks, data exfiltration, persistence and lateral movement across projects. Assessed by a 48-hour practical exam in a GCP lab followed by 48 hours to submit a report.
certification.currency_note: Course with lifetime access and one exam voucher that does not expire; page shows 'starting at' USD 700
